description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 107](https://identifiers.org/aop/107), "Constitutive androstane receptor activation leading to hepatocellular adenomas and carcinomas in the mouse and the rat". Key Event nodes and the relationships between them are from AOP-Wiki RDF 97191db (2026-08-01); the green pathway nodes are the molecular pathways mapped to each Key Event and approved in the molAOP Builder (snapshot 2026-08-13). The source AOP was developed in a non-human species; the mapped molecular pathways are human.
title: Constitutive androstane receptor activation leading to hepatocellular adenomas and carcinomas
